captions_note: the cards sit above the head and the follow pill under the caption line, so the reel's captions keep running
in_a_reel: the call to action at the end of the reel: start the slot about 0.5 s before the keyword is said, 4 to 7 s long
HANDLE and SUB are the buyer's real handle and a true line; no real product's logo or interface: it is a plain field
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's fonts and colours before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit HEADLINE, KEYWORD, HANDLE, REPLY, SUB in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the pace, the place and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
